title: Comparing two samplers fairly
hook: One render can name either winner. The same seeds, enough of them, a measure chosen first, and cost in model calls.

verified.claim: Toy numbers are copied from the course's measures.json and compared with it by hand.
Render numbers are copied from renders.json.
Heun calls the model about twice per step: 39 calls at 20 steps in the measurements.
Same-seed and different-seed tables come from the lab's simulation.

unchecked: No real comparison of samplers on pictures was run for this lesson. Every comparison table on pictures is one seed, or simulated.
The simulated sizes (seed effect 5, noise 1) are our choices, so 24% and the seed counts are illustrations, not measurements.
The claim that a seed moves a picture more than most sampler choices rests on our one-seed renders and general experience: it is not measured over many seeds.
